page_note: 该页是OECD报告第179页，仅含一个编号图 Figure 4.17，由A/B/C三个横向排列（上下堆叠）的国家排序柱状图面板组成，展示过度资格化可能性的百分点变化。

heading.title: Likelihood of over-qualification, by socio-demographic characteristics [1/2]
heading.subtitle: Change in likelihood of over-qualification (relative to reference category)

components.evidence: Panels A and C have a zero line with bars below it, ticks read -4 and -8
a heavy horizontal rule at 0 in Panels A and C from which bars grow up and down
Panel A tops at 4, Panel B runs 0 to 20, Panel C runs -8 to 8
dark banners read "A. Numeracy", "B. Years of education", "C. Older workers (Ref: Younger workers)"
three panels of the same country bar chart, one per socio-demographic characteristic
"OECD average" label set in bold with a pale blue band behind its bar in all three panels
bars are either dark navy or pale blue with no legend, e.g. Ireland pale, Estonia dark, same panel
all 32 country names set vertically, 90 degrees, under each panel baseline
category label reads "Poland*" in all three panels
"Percentage points" printed above the top tick (4 / 20 / 8) at the left of each panel
bare ticks 4, 0, -4, -8 scaled only by "Percentage points" above the axis
category labels include "Flemish Region (BE)" and "England (UK)" as jurisdiction codes in parentheses

new_components.name: category_highlight_band
new_components.evidence: a full-height pale blue vertical band spans the "OECD average" slot in each panel
new_components.why_it_matters: 读数时必须知道该淡蓝竖带并非数据（如预测区间），而只是标记基准类别，否则会误读为额外系列或区间。

new_components.name: per_panel_category_reordering
new_components.evidence: the same 32 countries appear in each panel but sorted descending by that panel's own value
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一国家在三个面板中位置不同，取值必须同时用面板名和国家名定位，不能按轴位置跨面板对齐。

new_components.name: category_separator_gridlines
new_components.evidence: a vertical rule is drawn between every country slot in addition to horizontal tick rules
new_components.why_it_matters: 密集竖线使柱体边界与网格线混淆，影响细柱高度判读。 线格柱体同色时更难分辨。

difficulty_notes: 取值精度是最大障碍：图上无任何数字标签，A面板刻度仅4、0、-4、-8，4个百分点约合55像素，要把 -1.3（OECD average）读到5%容差即 ±0.065pp，相当于不到1像素；C面板同样4pp一格，-2 这样的小值容差仅 ±0.1pp。B面板虽有0-20共6个刻度（4pp一格约40像素），但France 10.6、Switzerland 10.5、Japan 10.4、Spain 10.4 四根柱在像素上几乎等高，10 这个值无法唯一归属，读值与定位互相纠缠。相比之下标签层只需“面板名+国家名”两个键，可由表格承载。

suggestions.new_ablation_row: “三面板同类别不同排序 + 各自轴范围”对比“单面板”时的取值命中率

suggestions.what_to_add: axis_title_above_axis（单位词置于最高刻度之上）与四段式标题拆分（number/title/subtitle/unit）

suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位放在轴上方而非轴标题处时，导出表格是否仍带上 “Percentage points”

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 category_highlight_band（基准类别的全高淡色竖带 + 粗体标签）

suggestions.new_ablation_row: 存在高亮竖带时，模型是否把它误当作数据系列或区间

suggestions.where_to_change: readable 判定改为按每根柱可达精度打分，小值柱（|v|<2，刻度4pp）单独一档
